message_content: Aunt Song, the 2,000 yuan rent has been transferred to you via WeChat. Happy New Year and good health!
Jingjing, I made a fruit salad tonight — apples, bananas, blueberries — mixed with yogurt, it was super tasty! Come over to my place someday and let's make it together!
Nana, I received the gift! 'The Doctor's Progress' is exactly what I wanted. The handwritten card was so thoughtful. Thank you!
Brother Feng, Dad's liquid food is ready. I added yam and carrots, and the temperature is just right.
Nana, look at the photos I took at the morning market—they’re so full of everyday life!
Lin Wei, I'm too tired from just going back to work today, and I have to preview statistics class tonight. Can we reschedule badminton to Saturday?
Mom, I'm almost downstairs. I've brought you something good tonight, wait for me!
Wang Fang, the medical record has been completed and the nursing points have been communicated with the parents. Please ask the nurse station to pay attention.

Mom, I've put together a comparison of the apartments we visited. Huayuan Road has an elevator and good lighting; Jingsan Road is cheaper but has no elevator. Dad has trouble with his legs, so let's focus on Huayuan Road.
Wang Fang: Today's first aid training was really great. Let's form a team and sign up for the competition!
Me: Hello, Aunt Song, this is Xiaowen. Would it be convenient to meet you at the old house in Minghong Xincheng at 6 PM tonight to discuss the move? Thank you for your trouble.
Haoran, is it convenient to video call now? I have my questions ready.
Good morning! Today Mom made millet porridge and cold cucumber salad, super delicious. Have you had breakfast?
Mom, I'm heading to the hospital now. I may be back a little late tonight.
I've arrived at the hospital. Everything is going well, so don't worry.
Today I took Dad for rehabilitation, taught him exercises when we got back, and he even learned to use the Kindle. So happy.
Today I took a walk with my parents along the Dongfeng Canal. The willows by the river have turned green, and it was very pleasant.
Xiaowen, remember to have breakfast in the morning. It's colder today, so wear more clothes.
Wang Fang, the medical orders have been handled, and the exam book delivery has been picked up and placed in the cabinet.
Jingjing, my dad isn't cooperating with his rehabilitation. My mom got upset and they had a huge fight. I'm stuck in the middle and it's awful.
Me: Just sorted out old clothes for recycling and donated energy. It feels so good to be eco-friendly!
Fangfang, see you at 2 p.m. on Saturday — is it still the same bridal shop as last time?
Zhou Haoran, I listened to the abstract of the chi-square test paper you recommended. It was very inspiring, thank you!
Mom, it got colder this afternoon. Remember to put on more clothes.
Jingjing, the discussion is about to start — I've already entered the room!
Teacher Li, the ward round notes have been completed, and the discharge orders for Bed 4 have been checked.
Teacher Li, I have started entering the cerebral infarction case data and expect to finish by the morning.
Me: Suya, I made the little horse successfully! Let me show you the photo.
Mom, be safe coming over this afternoon. You should arrive in the evening, right? I'll have dinner ready and be waiting for you.
Mom, today we're going to the park to teach you how to pay with your phone. Bring your phone.
Mom, my legs are much better today, don't worry. You and Dad take care of yourselves.
Sun Yue, shall we meet at that braised noodle restaurant on Jingsan Road at 7 tonight? I haven't had it in a while and I'm craving it.
Jingjing, I've saved a few hairstyles. What do you think of this collarbone-length bob?
Teacher Li, hello! I would like to make an appointment with you to talk about my career concerns. I wonder if you are free tomorrow afternoon?
Liu Yang, I received the gift! The cured sausage and cookies are both awesome. My dad was especially happy. Thank you!
Me: Master Zheng, just woke up after the night shift and saw your morning message. I'll come find you another day to discuss the bisque stacking and firing with you.
Sister Qin, I may be able to get off work a bit early this afternoon after I finish up. Are you free to meet up tonight?

Dad, Mom and I are at Ditai Medical Equipment Store picking out a rehabilitation exercise bike. The salesperson recommended several models, and we've taken a liking to one with an LCD screen, priced at 3,500 yuan — it seems quite good.
Morning run check-in! Feeling in top form today.
Sister Min, Bed 3 needs its drainage tube changed. Please arrange it.
Dad, just now in the video I saw that you are walking much more steadily. That's great! Keep it up!
Mom, before you came this afternoon, I sorted out my review flashcards. When you get here, could you quiz me on brainstem syndrome?
Mom, remember to eat lunch. It's hot, watch out for heatstroke.

Dr. Liu, today’s handover: 28 medical records have been color-coded (green + red), beds 3 and 7 are new admissions, and consultations are pending scheduling. The list for tomorrow morning’s key ward rounds has been prepared; please check the system.
Jingjing, walking in the park. The sunshine is nice, taking deep breaths to relax, feeling good.
Wang Fang, I'm almost there. Traffic is a bit heavy, so I may be a few minutes late. Let's meet by the window in the cafe.
Mom, today I'm going to the Convention and Exhibition Center to attend a rehabilitation forum. I already had breakfast on the subway. I'll tell you about it when I come back in the evening.
Dr. Li, thank you for your encouragement today. I will work hard to accumulate cases of pottery art in rehabilitation. I have organized the notes, and I will consult you if I have questions later.
Mom, I sent Dad a massage back cushion. It should arrive the day after tomorrow. Please remind him to keep an eye out for it.
Xiaowen, the red-leaf photos are so beautiful! Full of autumn vibes!
Me: Bro, Dad was especially happy today. His eyes reddened when he ate the sweet and sour pork. We toasted him with tea instead of wine. He has recovered so well!
Mom, my free clinic is over today. I'll be home in the afternoon. Don't worry.
Mom, when installing the handrail, be careful to avoid the wires and water pipes. Call me if there's any problem.
Xiaowen, be safe when cycling, and remember to eat breakfast after the health check-up.
Me: Jingjing, I'm setting off for the convention center now and expect to arrive at 08:40. Is everything going well on your end?
Teacher Li, I've arrived at the hospital, changing into my white coat and getting ready for the shift handover.
Mom, I'm going to Decathlon to buy running shoes. I'll be back soon.
Mom, I'm driving to work now. I'll be careful on the road.
Xiaowen, don't forget to eat breakfast and take your iron supplement in the morning. No matter how busy work gets, take care of your health.
Mom, I have arrived at the hospital safely and am about to start work.

Xiaodong, here's Uncle Wang's new plan: elastic band resistance training to strengthen ankle dorsiflexion and eversion control, anatomically targeting the tibialis anterior and peroneus longus and brevis muscles. The key operation points are written on paper; I'll give them to you later.
Me: Fangfang, thanks for saving me a spot in tonight's yoga class; my shoulders and neck feel much more relaxed. Want to go together next time?
I've already arrived at the gym and am warming up. Hurry over!
Mom, I got home safely. I've just taken a shower and am ready to head out to the concert. Tonight is a Beethoven special—I'm really looking forward to it!
Mom, happy Thanksgiving! Thank you for the support and love that you and Dad have always given me. I love you!
Mom, I'm going to an exhibition today and I'll eat at home in the evening, so I won't be coming back.
Senior, regarding the Barthel Index data analysis for the rehabilitation case, you suggested using a paired t-test. Could you provide detailed guidance?
Me: Jingjing, I brewed some Jin Jun Mei with the new tea set today. It tastes wonderful!
Head Nurse, I'm taking half a day of comp time starting at 2:50 p.m. I've already completed my work and would like to report it for approval.
Me: Fangfang, I’ll come over in the evening to wrap up. Please help look after things in the afternoon.
Dr. Li, before today's ward rounds, I have prepared Mr. Wang's rehabilitation assessment form. We can start at any time.
Su Ya, the pottery income has been pocketed. I won't spend money carelessly at year-end, so I'll skip the market for now. See you at the next pottery class.
Daughter, night shifts are hard, congratulations on winning the award, take care of your health.

Antiplatelet drugs: aspirin at 8 AM every day, clopidogrel at 6 PM every day; speech therapy at 10 AM every day; passive limb training at 3 PM every day; go to the neurology department for a follow-up one week later (January 28 at 2 PM).

Bro, I just mentioned the move to Zhengzhou to Mom and Dad. I suggested renting a three-bedroom apartment near the hospital so it would be easier to take care of the family. Dad said he would think about it; I hope he agrees.
I heard you talked with the family of Bed 27 for a long time this morning. Was the family member of that stroke patient especially anxious?
Yes, we talked for about 15 minutes and explained the rehabilitation plan once; in the end, the family members calmed down a lot.

Daughter, I just made spicy pepper soup. Note the ingredients: beef bone broth, shredded cooked beef shank, shredded wood ear fungus, fried tofu puffs, day lily flowers, ground pepper, special spice powder, dark soy sauce for color, and sweet potato starch for thickening. Finally, sprinkle crushed peanuts and drizzle with aged vinegar and sesame oil. When you want to eat it later, follow this.
Daughter, I set up the family account authorization on the medical insurance platform as you said, and it has been bound to your name. Thank you!
Xiaowen, can you help me keep an eye on the residency trainees this afternoon?
No problem.
Yu Xiaowen, there's a slight change in tomorrow's department schedule. What do you think about the arrangement for the night shift? I think we can have Xiao Zhang do it. He's young and healthy.
Xiaowen, Aunt Zhao had a sudden heart attack and is hospitalized. I have to return to Luoyang immediately. Please take care of your father.

Xiaowen, I've noted everything you said on the phone. Don't worry, I'll help you communicate with the HR department on my end. Use these last few weeks to hand over your patients properly and hold the fort. Keep it up!

Hello, Ms. Yu. I am Wang Mingyuan, a wealth management consultant at China Merchants Bank. Based on our communication on February 20, the optimization of your monthly fund investment plan has been confirmed. Starting from next month's deduction date, the monthly amount will be increased to 2,500 yuan and a new bond-biased fund will be added. Please ensure your account balance is sufficient.
Navigate to the Luoyang Central Hospital on Zhongzhou Middle Road; see you at the ground parking lot! My dad is counting on you tonight!
OK

Siyu, big breakthrough in pottery today! I made three pieces, and Master Zheng said my technique is steady now, and the music and clay merged—a real breakthrough! I also made that ceramic tag you wanted; I'll give it to you next time.
Su Ya, look at the prototype of my new work today! Next week we can play together.
WeChat Pay success notification: You have paid 800.00 yuan to Nitu Zhijian Pottery Studio to enroll in the pottery course.
The dipping sauce needs garlic and vinegar to be fragrant 😊
Wow, you're amazing, Wen! The patterns look so delicate—we must set up a gathering next time!
Hello Yu Xiaowen, please check in at the AED Room on the second floor of the Clinical Skills Training Center at 10:25 AM on September 24, and pick up the latest AHA Basic Life Support guidelines.
Mom made hulatang and fried dough cakes. I'm stuffed. I've confirmed Dad took his medicine, and I'm about to set off back to Zhengzhou.
Dad, you're amazing!!

In tonight's group reading discussion of the first chapter of Becoming, I shared my shift from pursuing perfection to accepting imperfection, especially in medical work, the process from rushing to make quick, correct diagnoses to understanding uncertainty. Thank you all for the resonance and encouragement!
The pottery tools you gave me are amazing, thank you!
[Payment successful] You have successfully enrolled in the systematic training in medical English, and the first month fee of 299 yuan has been paid.
Let's have lunch together at the hospital cafeteria at noon. See you at 12!
[China Merchants Bank] Your debit card ending in 1234 spent RMB 658.00 at 09:15 on April 5. Merchant: JD.com.
Your Kindle has arrived at the parcel station at the community entrance. Please pick it up as soon as possible.
I've arrived. I ordered the chopped chili fish head and am waiting for you.
I'm off work now, I'll be there in twenty minutes!
Xiaowen, it was so nice to have dinner and chat with you at today's wedding banquet! The pottery gift you gave was so thoughtful — Wang Fang must have been really moved.
Today I cleaned out the wardrobe with my mom, picked out 13 pieces of unused clothing, and planned to send them for recycling.
Alipay: You paid 899.00 yuan via Alipay at 12:30 on February 5, 2025. Merchant: Medical Statistics Course.
[Zhengzhou Jihe Rehabilitation Center] You have successfully paid the daily physical therapy fee starting from April 5. Order No.: JH20250401001. Amount: 3500 yuan.
Thank you so much today! The mermaid and A-line main wedding dresses we finally chose, and that champagne-colored bridesmaid dress, are simply perfect!
Hurry up, hurry up! Your brother's flight is at noon—don't miss it! Your dad walks slowly, so help him along.
Xiaowen, the data analysis results you reported today were very good. I suggest you organize them into a case series abstract and submit it to the Youth Forum.
Dad, you're amazing!!

Teacher Li used a red pen to mark that the unit for joint range of motion should be unified as 'degrees,' and that the daily living ability section also needed to be more specific. After I revised it and got her signature, she even praised me.
This morning I helped Dad wash up, measured his blood pressure, and supervised him taking his medicine. Then the whole family ate spicy soup and fried dough cakes together. It was quite fulfilling.
Ran 2 kilometers along the Luo River this morning. The air was really fresh.
Already operated according to the plan: redeemed 10,000 yuan of the fund and suspended the recurring investment. Thank you for the demonstration.
Xiaowen, I've arrived at Daxue Road in Erqi District. Have you arrived?
Credit card ending in 1234 paid 3,700 yuan to Rehabilitation Home Medical Devices on 2025-08-11 18:45 for the purchase of a nursing bed.
Xiaowen, forwarding this month's market briefing to remind you to pay attention to bond volatility risk.
Cainiao Station reminds you that the package ending in 1234 (Jin Jun Mei black tea) has been picked up.

Today I reported to the rehabilitation department. Sister Lin took me to meet Director Zhang Lei, and then Teacher Zhou Jie showed me around the department. I also visited the physical therapy hall, occupational therapy room, and speech therapy room. The environment is nice and it feels quite professional.
Dr. Li Wei: The newly admitted vertigo patient has been taken care of. The video head impulse test for Bed 25 will be done at 14:00.

China Merchants Bank reminder: You have successfully adjusted the monthly automatic fund investment ratio from 30% to 15%, and the released funds have been transferred to Zhaozhaobao (money market fund).
Arrived.
Boss, please wrap that bouquet of white daisies, pink carnations, and purple balloon flowers beautifully; I will pick it up later.
Just left Shenghuali; I glazed the zodiac rooster and will pick up the finished piece in a week.
Xiaowen, tonight’s tea gathering was wonderful! The lingering aroma of Fenghuang Dancong is unforgettable, and chatting with you is always so happy. Let’s meet again next time—my treat!
I'm sending you a video—your dad walked over ten steps with the walker today. Take a quick look!
Had a great time playing ball tonight, met Xiao Zhou, let's meet again next time!
Great teamwork in doubles today, let's play again next time!

[WeChat] Dr. Wang from the Affiliated Hospital of Xinxiang Medical University requests to add you as a friend, with the message: Hello, I am Dr. Wang who spoke with you just now in the poster presentation area. I look forward to further discussing stroke rehabilitation experience.
Received the sketch, great! I proposed using purple clay, white porcelain, and coarse pottery for a four-seasons theme, and agreed to go to Between the Earth on the afternoon of May 6.
You have successfully registered for the Internal Medicine convenience visit. Visit time: 12:10. Location: Laboratory Department, 2nd Floor, Outpatient Building.
Dr. Wang, it was a pleasure to meet you at the booth. I look forward to further online communication!
Mom, have you arrived in Zhengzhou? What should we eat tonight?
Just now in the car, chatting about interesting things in Shenzhen was really fun.
I'm almost there, take your time eating.
Brother, Dad and I are taking a walk along the Yellow River bank. I'm in a very good mood listening to him tell stories about standing guard at the Yellow River Bridge in Luoyang when he was young.
Dad, Mom, you rest well. I'll come to see you again tomorrow. Drive home carefully, and let me know once you're home.
The Kindle arrived. I spent the evening reading with Dad, and it felt great.
Xiaowen, your dad can walk now! We're so happy for you all. Tonight's video moved us all.
Bro! Mom and Dad agreed!
Mom, look at the book I just found, "Stories of Luoyang's Old City" — it reminds me of when we went to the bookstore together during Spring Festival.
Today at the workshop, Master Zheng taught me the secret of the tail's curve. I recorded it. So happy!
Today at the Nizhiyu Workshop, I mixed two types of transparent glaze, ready to apply glaze to the zodiac rooster. Looking forward to the result!
Changed the paper keyword from clinical research to neurorehabilitation, which is more precise.
Director Zhang, I found 6 errors in the citations while checking them before submission, and they have been corrected. Please review the latest version.
Xiaowen, I heard your department transfer was approved? Congratulations!
Thanks! Come visit often after you report in.
I just finished writing a few cards, and the audience was quite moved. How are things on your end?

Su Ya, after the exhibition closes tonight, let's go eat at Old Luoyang Noodle Restaurant! Sister Zhao Min and Master Zheng Guodong will also come, let's celebrate the success of the first day of the exhibition～

Su Ya, the new story cards are in the left drawer of the display stand. Could you keep an eye on the audience's reactions to the two stories 'The Crooked Teacup' and 'Hand Holding a Round Ball'? Let me know anytime if there's feedback.
Just passed by Xiyuan Plaza, the Christmas lights are so beautiful, and I'm feeling great!
[China Construction Bank] A transfer of 800 yuan was received in your account ending in 120 at 10:15 on December 14, with the note: Wang Fang purchased a crackle-glaze teacup.
Finished the exhibition teardown today; total exhibition revenue was 2,710 yuan.
Arrived at the Shenghuali underground parking lot.

Xiaowen, in the afternoon an elderly couple were moved by the 'filial piety story' and wrote warm wishes in the guestbook. Moreover, by closing time, most of the small pottery pieces in the display case had been sold.
I just got home. It snowed heavily and the roads were slippery, so I drove slowly and got to the building at 20:23.
The customer took away four zodiac rooster pottery plates custom-made in September; they were all very satisfied, took a photo together, and said they would bring friends.

At noon, I had a bowl of shredded pork noodle soup at the underground food court of the Convention and Exhibition Center. It tasted good, and in the afternoon I continued looking at the poster presentations.

Hello, this is Yu Xiaowen. The final version of the poster has been sent via WeChat. Please confirm the printing specifications (whether it should be in color, paper size, etc.) and the pickup time. Thank you.
contactName: Staff member of Dongyuan Graphic Advertising Shop

message_content: Thank you for today's conversation. Looking forward to a more in-depth online discussion later.
[WeChat Pay] You paid 2.00 yuan to Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop on 2025-08-28 at 07:28 for vegetable and vermicelli buns.
Dr. Wang, I'm glad we talked again this morning. I've kept your business card, and I'm looking forward to working together.
Lin Wei: How are the annual meeting preparations going? Me: Basically ready, see you tomorrow.
Aunt Li, I received the local specialties you sent today. They're delicious! I just shared them with my parents over video, and they loved them too. Thank you!
Sweetie, it was really great teaching Mom pottery this morning. The more I look at the dish she made, the more I think it would be just right as an ashtray, haha.
Today your dad brewed his treasured Xinyang Maojian tea, and we chatted all afternoon. He talked about making blackboard posters for National Day when he was young. It was really nice.
Today I went for a walk with my dad in the community. We ran into Uncle Liu, who praised Dad for recovering so well. Two laps, 20 minutes—I'm really happy!
This morning I ran in Luopu Park. The air was really fresh, and I saw an elderly man practicing tai chi.
Xiaowen, your dad fell asleep as soon as he got home. I gave him a glass of warm water. He's sleeping soundly now.
I've already taken the medicine, don't worry.
Today I played two games of Chinese chess with Dad, and each of us won one. What a satisfying match!
Xiaowen, you helped serve rice and wash dishes at dinner today. Mom was very moved. Thanks for your hard work!
Today I accompanied Dad through 3 sets of rehabilitation exercises, 20 reps each. He was in good shape. During breaks, we watched the sports channel together and talked about his younger days.
Today I cleaned up the kitchen with Mom. I just showered and am getting ready for bed.
Mom, the rehearsal for the hospital anniversary went very smoothly, don't worry!
Signed up as a first-aid volunteer and received a supportive reply.
The porridge and side dishes are on the table in the rest area; eat them while they're hot.
I'll ask for leave right away and be there tomorrow or the day after!

Cousin, Dad is in stable condition and is receiving treatment in the hospital. Don't worry, and there's no need to make a special trip. The hospital is not convenient for visits. I'll take good care of Mom and Dad. I'll contact you if anything comes up.
The heart failure patient is stable, so rest assured and take care of your family.
[XX Bank] Your savings account ending in 1234 made a purchase of 20.00 yuan at 2025-01-15 14:28, with a balance of 2345.67 yuan after the transaction. Payee: Luoyang Taxi Company. [XX Bank]
Mom, I'll catch the 1:05 high-speed rail and arrive before 2. Is Dad conscious now? You must stay calm.
Mom, you should go home and rest. Come back tomorrow morning. I can stay here and watch over Dad.
Reading about mental resilience in the ward. At my father's bedside is truly a lesson in professional growth.
Your dad suddenly started slurring his speech and can't move his left side. Come to the hospital right away!
My dad had a cerebral infarction; I'm on my way to Luoyang. Do you know anything about the Neurology Department of Luoyang Central Hospital?
Dad's facial droop improved slightly this morning. He can open his eyes and respond to me now. The doctor says he is recovering well.

[Order Confirmation] Hello, Yu Xiaowen. The millet porridge and steamed egg custard you ordered for your father, Mr. Yu, are ready. Please pick them up at the nurse station. Wishing him a speedy recovery!
Xiaowen, I've brought your meal: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, crucian carp soup, and rice. I'll be at the hospital soon.
Mom, I ordered porridge and some side dishes in the cafeteria. They'll be brought to the ward soon. Don't worry.
Hello caregiver, I have ordered millet porridge and steamed egg custard for breakfast. Could you please help feed my father? Thank you!
Teacher Li, I plan to return to Zhengzhou on Monday. Please take care of the department matters.
Xiaowen, I'm staying at the hospital tonight to look after him. Go home and get a good sleep, and come back tomorrow to take over for me. Don't worry, Mom is here.
I'll pick you up at the gate at 12:30 and take you to Longmen Station.
Dad's indicators are all improving today, and his mental state is good too. Rest assured.
What a relief, that's great. You should also take care of yourself, don't get too tired.
Bro, I'm already in the car. Don't worry.
Dad is awake and alert; see the photo in the MMS.
I've arrived home. How is Dad doing this afternoon?
Brother, the rehabilitation plan has been handed over. Please follow the notes.
Mom, I'll video call you when I get home tonight, and we'll do it together. Brother, you can take a look first.
Mom, I'll head back to Zhengzhou tomorrow. Brother will take care of Dad during the day, and you take care of him at night. Once Dad is stable, we can discuss the next steps.
Bought protein powder, now going to the hospital.
You're here? Then I'll head back first. Thanks for your hard work.
Okay, bro, go back and rest.
Arrived at Yanjun Spicy Soup and bought the two-in-one mix that Dad wanted.
Hello, Teacher Li. Regarding my father’s rehabilitation plan, I’d like to discuss the specific schedule and training content with you. Would tomorrow morning be convenient for you?
Try to return to Luoyang next weekend
Wenwen, remember to pack your dad's change of clothes tonight; I need to take them to the hospital tomorrow.
Just went to Dazhang Supermarket with Mom and bought a grip ball for Dad's rehabilitation.
Put on the down jacket, hat, and gloves, bring the thermos and backpack, and get ready to walk from her parents' home to the hospital.
Got it, regular shift tomorrow, morning meeting as usual.
Remember to buy Chinese yam and pork ribs to nourish you.
Medical-grade anti-slip rehabilitation slippers and a no-drill bedside handrail, 302 yuan in total, paid, with a note for express delivery.
Brother, you were right during tonight's walk. I'm getting more and more interested in rehabilitation medicine and want to try studying deeper in this direction.
Mom, I've bought the groceries and packed the clothes. I'll be right back at the hospital.

Hello, Rehabilitation Therapist Wang, this is Yu Xiaowen. We just discussed the discharge procedure for tomorrow. I would like to confirm the precautions for taking the antiplatelet medication among the discharge medications, such as the specific time and dosage. Thank you!
Your savings card ending in 1234 was debited XXXX yuan at 10:20 on 2025-01-27. Memo: Inpatient settlement at Luoyang Central Hospital.
Tonight I stir-fried tomatoes with eggs and garlic broccoli, and my mother cooked millet pumpkin porridge. We enjoyed the meal very much!
Mom said Dad is doing well today and ate a lot more than yesterday. It seems he is recovering well.
Dear Yu Xiaowen, your father can be discharged tomorrow (January 27). Please pick up the notice at the nurses' station this afternoon.
Xiaowen, I've read your rehabilitation notes. They're really detailed, and Dad's progress is recorded clearly. Awesome! Let's talk more over dinner tonight.
Dad, this afternoon you will do sitting balance training, 15 minutes each session.
The cafeteria has sweet and sour pork today. Come quickly!
Look at the several cup handle designs I drew; I'll show you in the video.
Daughter, I'm so glad to hear your dad can walk 25 meters now! You've worked hard, take care of yourselves, and I'll go see you in a few days.
No problem, I'll adjust the team-building games in the afternoon. Go ahead and don't worry.
I put the morning meeting materials on your desk. Today's focus is the plan for Bed 5.
My brother's train arrives at Zhengzhou East Station at about 2:40 p.m., and I will go pick him up.
Tomorrow I'll go for a walk at the Yellow River Scenic Area. The weather is good for clearing my mind.
Okay.
Dr. Wang suggested installing an L-shaped stainless steel handrail at a height of 75 cm in the bathroom and laying PVC floor mats with an anti-slip coefficient of R10 or higher on the floor.

When I accompanied Dad for his assessment today, I asked Dr. Wang about the bathroom renovation at home. He said the previous plan was good, and we just need to keep the 75cm grab bar, R10 floor mat, and nursing bed.
Haoran, is there any talent show at the gathering tomorrow?
Mom, there's a department dinner tomorrow. I'll call you the day after tomorrow.
In the kitchen helping Mom prep vegetables; she agreed to make steamed sea bass.
Tonight I made sweet and sour pork. I used the light soy sauce and dark soy sauce I bought last time. It tasted great!
The weather is nice today. Let's go to the Wangfujing Department Store supermarket to buy some mooncakes and osmanthus.
[China Merchants Bank] Your credit card ending in 5201 has successfully paid 6000 yuan
Dad, I've noted down tonight's video discussion. I'll send you the training schedule tomorrow.
I had just sent Mom (drink more hot water, don't catch a cold), and then something happened to Dad.
Mom, it’s colder today, you and Dad
How was the coffee you had at Jingmi Shiguang today?
The Americano is good.
Sure, let's go together. We'll contact each other on WeChat later.
Catch a nap; call me if anything comes up.
Mom, I received the hot drink that brother brought. Thanks!
The meeting is about to begin; I'm waiting for you in the conference room.
Just arrived at Shenghuali Pottery Studio. Tonight I'm going to make a cup for fun.
I'm at the braised noodle restaurant. Teacher Li Wei is here too. Hurry over!
Gather in front of the outpatient building at 7 a.m. and bring the free clinic supplies.
The dumplings are made, waiting for you to come home and eat. It's cold, drink plenty of warm water.
Tomorrow at 8 a.m. I'll wait for you in the ward, and I'll bring some liquid food ingredients along.
Your dad did the bridge exercise very well, and he has taken the medicine as you said: aspirin after breakfast and atorvastatin in the evening.
This gait monitoring might be useful for my father; can you help me evaluate it?
Don't forget to play ball tonight. Oh, by the way, I have a friend in Shenzhen who works on AI algorithms and might be able to help with your rehabilitation. Let's talk more later.
Your dad heard you were coming back, so he ate an extra bowl of rice at lunch.
Then I'll leave earlier in the afternoon and get there earlier.
Mom, I'm about to set off. Wait for me!
Okay, be careful on the way. Your dad is so happy that you're coming back.
Play basketball at Maiya Gymnasium at 8 PM
OK
In the morning I told my parents that I would go buy bathroom grab bars and non-slip mats after work, and they were very happy.
Sister Li, the director has agreed to reduce my night shifts from twice a week to once a week. Could you adjust the schedule for next month?
Mom, today Dad did 20 sets of ankle pump exercises, 5 more sets than yesterday. His arm lifts are much steadier too. With fewer night shifts, I really have the energy to practice with him.

Just video-chatted with my parents about the Huayuan Road apartment; they are very satisfied, and I promised to shoot a video over the weekend. I also sent the photos and dimensions to my brother. He will transfer the rent difference next week, and we've agreed to do an online re-viewing next weekend.
Just had a video call with my parents. I saw Dad walk about 60 steps with the walker. He's made great progress. I'm really happy.
